$comment: Template: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN} is substituted at render time. Produce a submittable manifest with `python scripts/render_manifests.py --env prod` (or --env dev), or fetch the rendered document from a running server at GET /manifests/claude_connector.json, which fills in the origin it was reached on.
name: financial-portfolios-ai
description: Connect Claude to Financial Portfolios AI to analyze quantitative portfolios, inspect target asset allocations, calculate rebalancing alignment arithmetic, and read institutional market research. Subscribers see the live book; other signed-in users see the public book delayed by ~45 days. (Informational only under publisher exclusion; not individualized financial advice).

streamable_http.description: Recommended remote Streamable HTTP transport for Claude Connectors on web & cloud

stdio.description: Standard I/O transport for local Claude Desktop and Claude Code CLI

authentication.instructions: Add this server as a custom connector in Claude (Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector), paste the server URL, and sign in when prompted - OAuth 2.1, no API key to paste. Command-line clients (Claude Code, local stdio) instead pass a personal token via the X-API-Key header.

oauth2.description: A tokenless request to /mcp is answered with 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=... (RFC 9728), which is what starts the sign-in flow in Claude.

api_key.description: For command-line and local stdio clients, which do not run the OAuth flow: generate a personal token at Settings > API Tokens and pass it as X-API-Key (or as FINANCIAL_PORTFOLIOS_API_TOKEN for stdio).

tools.name: open_portfolio_explorer
tools.description: Open the interactive Portfolio Explorer (MCP App): a portfolio dropdown, sortable holdings, sector and concentration charts, changes over time, a side-by-side comparison of two or three portfolios, and a search for which portfolios hold a stock. Renders inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: open_access_centre
tools.description: Open the Access & Connection panel (MCP App): which model portfolios this account can see, which are live versus delayed by about 45 days, what the delayed book withholds, and how this client is signed in. Renders inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: open_rebalance_studio
tools.description: Open the Rebalance Studio (MCP App): review current holdings - read from a connected brokerage connector where the user has one, typed or pasted otherwise - and calculate the difference between them and a target model portfolio. Arithmetic only; it places no orders. Renders inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: open_research_reader
tools.description: Open the Research Reader (MCP App): browse and search Financial Portfolios AI research, read a post in place, and see which posts mention tickers held in the user's model portfolios. Renders inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: open_breadth_board
tools.description: Open the Breadth Board (MCP App): which stocks are held across several of the user's model portfolios and at what weight, how much each pair of portfolios overlaps by name and by weight, and each book's dominant sector and concentration. Renders inline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description: List every active quantitative investment portfolio (e.g. AQA_AGGRESSIVE, AQA_BALANCED, AQA_DEFENSIVE), each marked access = subscribed (live book) or public_delayed (holdings delayed ~45 days).

tools.name: get_portfolio_allocation
tools.description: Retrieve a target allocation snapshot: the latest book with expected returns and risk metrics for subscribed portfolios, or the public book delayed ~45 days (ticker/weight/sector only) otherwise. Response carries access, delayed, as_of and lag_days.

tools.name: get_portfolio_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical allocation snapshots over a custom time window (up to 365 days). Non-subscribers receive only entries at or before today - 45 days, with null allocation metrics.

tools.name: get_portfolio_performance
tools.description: Hypothetical, simulated performance for a model portfolio: the indexed curve against its benchmark plus since-inception statistics (total and annualized return, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, beta, alpha, information ratio, tracking error, correlation). Carries its own disclosure, which must be shown with the figures.

tools.name: get_portfolio_metrics
tools.description: Best and worst performing holdings with their simulated return, most-held names with company names and average weight, and win rates by name and by invested capital. Carries its own disclosure, which must be shown with the figures.

tools.name: get_portfolio_concentration
tools.description: Concentration and sector mix for a model portfolio - top-5 and top-10 weight, largest holding, effective number of holdings, weight by sector and the dominant sector. Derived from published weights, so available on the delayed book too.

tools.name: get_portfolio_changes
tools.description: What a model portfolio added, removed and re-weighted over a period, plus one-way turnover. Reports the model's own weight decisions, not returns.

tools.name: rebalance_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate mathematical target-model alignment arithmetic (share quantity differences) given user holdings (max 200 rows, 512 KB). Requires an active subscription covering the target portfolio.

tools.name: get_rebalance_template
tools.description: Download the standard CSV template format and guidelines for uploading user portfolio holdings.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Search and list published quantitative research articles, market updates, and investment commentaries.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieve full content of a published research article by slug.

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Inspect active API token metadata, usage rate limits, and subscription status.

prompts.name: my_portfolios
prompts.title: My portfolios at a glance
prompts.description: See which model portfolios you subscribe to and what each one holds right now, plus the other portfolios available on a delayed basis.

prompts.name: access_help
prompts.title: My access and subscription
prompts.description: Explains what your account can see: live vs 45-day-delayed holdings, which portfolios you subscribe to, and what needs a subscription.

prompts.name: portfolio_review
prompts.title: Review a model portfolio
prompts.description: In-depth look at one model portfolio: holdings and weights, sector mix, concentration, and equity vs cash.

prompts.name: portfolio_changes
prompts.title: What changed in a portfolio
prompts.description: Shows how a model portfolio's holdings changed over a period: positions added, removed, and the biggest weight shifts.

prompts.name: compare_portfolios
prompts.title: Compare model portfolios
prompts.description: Side-by-side comparison of the model portfolios: risk level, holdings, sector mix, concentration, and overlap.

prompts.name: find_holding
prompts.title: Which portfolios hold a stock
prompts.description: Look up a stock across the model portfolios: which ones hold it, at what weight, and in which sector.

prompts.name: portfolio_report
prompts.title: Interactive portfolio report
prompts.description: Builds an interactive report for a model portfolio: sortable holdings, sector and concentration charts, and recent changes, as a shareable page.

prompts.name: rebalance_advisor
prompts.title: Align my holdings to a model
prompts.description: Walks you through comparing your own holdings with a model portfolio and calculates the share differences. Requires a subscription to that portfolio.

prompts.name: market_research_digest
prompts.title: Research digest
prompts.description: Summarises the latest research articles and market commentary, optionally on one topic.
